posts.author: Edwin Ng
posts.text:
618 YishunNoticed the pork lard had some skin and wanted to revisit. This time I noticed the carrot cake stall was open and asked if I can order one. Old aunty said “Yes can and won’t take so long.”. I the ordered a $5.50 HKM + $4 ingredients + egg fried into noodles and + 1 sunny side up. Don’t know why but had two yolks. I think it’s quite common for her eggs to have two yolks.  Carrot cake was just superb. Won’t elaborate but I get why the queue is so long and I won’t mind ordering it and wait while I eat something else.  HKM was mild in flavor but since I added eggs and there were so much ingredients, it was quite a healthy meal. The pork lard and skin….plenty of good fats and collagen. I understand why so many people revisit. It’s relatively healthy compared to some others, and it’s quite a big portion. Prawns were huge and firm, and was nicely seasoned. Glad to have this as the last HKM for this lunar new year. I couldn’t finish and had to waste food. Sigh. I made it up by fasting the rest of the day and made it my only meal for the day. 618 Yishun Ring Rd, Singapore 760618
+2

posts.author: Samuel Lim
posts.text:
So today I was at Golden Mile, and of course I had to try one of the famous old school HKM. There’s been a lot of criticism here about the aunty being bad tempered and the portions being small. But here is my review and experience.I went straight for the $8 plate. It came with 3 prawns and a generous amount of sotong and noodles. I enjoyed it so much I ordered another $8 plate. The first plate was fried drier, which I preferred. The second one was slightly wetter, but still good. Honestly… look at the portion….. is it really that small?As for the service, both the aunty and uncle were friendly to me throughout. So if you smile and make small talk with the hawkers, they will be friendly back also one la

Feng Hokkien Mee @ 505 Jurong WestHad my HKM fix earlier today as I was nearby Boon Lay area. $8 portion with 5 prawns and generous pork belly. For wet HKM lovers this is definately worth a try and I can say Neighbourwok has some competition coming! Chilli is power and used a packet of tissue for me  Not sure if anyone feels that one of the chef looks like from Born HKM @ BB which closed down earlier… maybe next round I’ll ask him.

posts.author: Samuel Lim
posts.text: I finally made it here to 69 FHKM in Bedok and I’m very happy to report that this is really one of the better ones (made it to my personal top 10 favourite). I especially like the mild wok hei and type of stock used. The stock is the more savory kind and not the sweet type which I dislike. Prawns were a little soft and tasteless but I like that he made the effort to devein and butterfly the prawns. Lard very fragrant and crispy. Chilli needs abit more oomph ( prefer youfu, shiok or fungyi chilli) but overall a very good plate. I will definitely return again.
